MissionSettings.MissionName: Reveal and Remove the Bandit Threat
MissionSettings.Blurb: This will be brief. You will be dropped in the southwest. The Gulag is under complete Steiner control and is located in the central area of your Tac Map. They are holding some innocent Liao Loyalists and their families, as well as a number of local leaders. This displeases the Mandrissa. Capture the Gulag Headquarters and eliminate its Defenders. Once you've secured the Gulag, we'll send a column of ambulances and transport vehicles to evacuate the prisoners. Renard can be expected to counter-attack, so call in whatever support vehicles you see fit.
